summary.name: Better Analyst
summary.one_liner: Better Analyst (formerly Formula Bot) is an AI data analyst that answers plain-English questions over connected data sources and produces charts, dashboards, reports and scheduled alerts.
use_cases: ask questions about spreadsheets or CSV files in plain English
build live dashboards from Google Analytics or Search Console
schedule automated reports that refresh on a timer
set email or Slack alerts when a metric changes
share dashboards with clients using per-viewer row rules
query SQL databases like PostgreSQL or Snowflake without writing SQL
summary.what_it_does: Better Analyst lets users upload Excel, CSV, TSV or PDF files or connect sources such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Salesforce, Tableau, Power BI, BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks and several SQL databases. Users ask questions in natural language and receive charts, insights, spreadsheets and data models. The page says it shows the calculations and code behind complex transformations so outputs can be checked. Dashboards, scheduled refreshes, alerts (email, plus Slack on Team) and shared dashboards for viewers are described. Projects can separate each client's sources, chats and dashboards.
notable: Connects to a wide range of sources including GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, BigQuery, Snowflake and PostgreSQL
Shows calculations and code behind transformations for verification
Per-member row-level rules and isolated sandbox per chat
Alerts can be previewed against 30/60/90 days of history before saving
caveats: Several features (client Projects, shared dashboards with row rules, Slack alerts, SSO) are tied to the Team or Enterprise plans
Accuracy depends on data quality and question clarity, per the page
Refunds are limited to requests within 30 days of the latest payment and under 50 billable messages or requests
